definitions.gloss: era name; name of an imperial era
definitions.explanation: A name assigned to a period of years in the Japanese calendar system, traditionally changing with each new emperor. Examples include 令和 (Reiwa), 平成 (Heisei), and 昭和 (Shōwa).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年号|ねんごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧です。
examples.english: The current era name is Reiwa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{年号|ねんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧とき、⟦{日本中|にほんじゅう}→日本中：28045_nihonjuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}した→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧。
examples.english: When the new era name was announced, all of Japan paid attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{年号|ねんごう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われていて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年号|ねんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Japan both the Western calendar and era names are used, and official documents often use the era name.

notes:
A fundamental concept in Japanese culture and daily life. Government documents, official forms, and many business documents use the {年号|ねんごう} system alongside or instead of the Western calendar (⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧). Learners in Japan will encounter {年号|ねんごう} on everything from insurance forms to driver's licenses.

RECENT ERA NAMES:
- ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧ (2019-present)
- ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧ (1989-2019)
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧ (1926-1989)
- {大正|たいしょう} (1912-1926)
- ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧ (1868-1912)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年号|ねんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: for the era name to change
- {年号|ねんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use the era name system
- {新|しん}{年号|ねんごう}: new era name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧: era name — synonymous; ⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧ is the more formal/official term, while {年号|ねんごう} is more commonly used in daily conversation
- ⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧: Western calendar year — the Gregorian calendar system, the alternative to {年号|ねんごう}
- ⟦{和暦|われき}→和暦：28485_wareki⟧: Japanese calendar — the calendar system based on {年号|ねんごう}
